title: Riskline
subtitle: Your stop, target and P&L at a glance on Even G2
note: recorded from the Even Hub simulator, paper trading on live Binance prices
outroNote: Binance market data  ·  Spot Testnet bridge  ·  voice

scenes.caption: Live prices from Binance. No position yet, so the card shows the market.
Swipe to the next symbol, and back.
Tap for the actions that make sense right now.
Buy 100 USDT. The stop, the target and the risk are spelled out before anything is sent.
Every new position starts with a stop and a target. The gauge shows where the price sits between them.
Tap again: with a position open, the list leads with ways to cut risk.
Hold the touchpad and say "sell half". (No microphone in an automated run: this transcript is scripted.)
Speech never sends an order by itself. It opens the same confirmation a tap would.
Tap to confirm: half is off.
The system menu works from any screen: flatten everything.
Flatten all asks once, then closes every position and cancels its orders.
